title: Dimension of base-change
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure], let $k\to k\prime$ be a field extension, and let $f:C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be a separated, locally finite type, quasi-compact morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], with $\dim |C|\le0$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Put $C_{k\prime}=C\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}k\prime$ and let $\pi:C_{k\prime}\to C$ be the projection [def-pc-base-change]. Then $\dim |C_{k\prime}|\le0$.

source.place: Tag 00P4, via locally quasi-finite base change and Artinian criterion

proof.text: Every subset of C is discrete (IsDiscrete.univ.mono). The criterion locallyQuasiFinite_iff_isDiscrete_preimage_singleton makes f locally quasi-finite. Base change makes pullback.snd locally quasi-finite over Spec k-prime, hence its source locally Artinian by IsLocallyArtinian.of_locallyQuasiFinite. Apply its discrete topology instance and topologicalKrullDim_zero_of_discreteTopology.
